component.name: YouTube Comment Extractor
component.summary: Extract, filter, and export YouTube comments with GTK4 and multi-format reports

description.p: YouTube Comment Extractor is a native GTK4 and Libadwaita desktop application designed for researchers, creators, and data analysts to harvest, inspect, and export YouTube video comments and reply trees.
Featuring an integrated login browser to harvest Netscape cookies, the application easily bypasses rate limits and age gates while keeping all data stored locally on your machine.

ul.li: Full Comment Tree Extraction: Downloads top-level comments, nested replies, author metadata, like counts, and timestamps
Built-in Cookie Harvester: Mini-browser for authentication without manual cookie export extensions
Multi-Format Export: One-click export to CSV (preserving emojis and special characters), structured JSON, and HTML tables
Statistical Sampling: Uniform random and bounded Poisson sampling modes for large datasets
Dual Backend Support: Run scraping tasks via local processes or delegate to the Dockerized extractor service

description.p: Updated app icons conforming with GNOME Human Interface Guidelines, multi-resolution icon theme packages, and multi-format export parity.
